A.name: Climbing Strength
A.focus: Glutes, hamstrings and single-leg control. 40–50 min.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.tip: Soft knees, hips back, flat back. Feel the hamstrings, then drive the hips forward.

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.tip: Whole foot on the box. Drive through the heel and stand tall at the top.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.tip: Feet hip-width apart. Lower with control. Do not lock the knees.

exercises.name: Hamstring curl
exercises.tip: Hips stay on the pad. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Calf press
exercises.tip: Full range: deep stretch at the bottom, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.tip: Elbows under the shoulders, straight line from head to heels.

B.name: Descending Durability
B.focus: Eccentric quads, posterior chain and posture. 40–50 min.

exercises.name: Controlled step-downs
exercises.tip: Lower slowly from a box, tap the heel lightly, knee in line with the toes.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.tip: Press through mid-foot, slow on the way down. Do not lock the knees.

exercises.name: Prone hamstring curls
exercises.tip: Hips down, curl the heels toward the glutes, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raises
exercises.tip: From a step: heel down, then a high raise. Pause at the top.

exercises.name: Back extensions
exercises.tip: Hinge at the hips and lift to a straight line only. Do not over-arch.

exercises.name: Low rows
exercises.tip: Chest up, elbows back, squeeze the shoulder blades.

rules: Move with control, slow on the way down.
Keep 2–3 reps in reserve in every set.
Heavy legs on Sunday? Move session B to Thursday, after the speed session.
